summary: Police welcome neighborhood watch groups and free home checks but tell residents not to act as heroes.
realLife: At a burglary meeting a chief reported the recent count and where the thefts clustered, offered free home security checks, put plainclothes officers on patrol, supported watch groups and warned residents against taking matters into their own hands or arming themselves unlawfully.
